resources.string: This launcher does not support adding a custom shortcut
Request submitted. Confirm the launcher prompt; the shortcut has not yet been confirmed.
Unable to update the home screen icon. Try again later or check launcher settings.
Unable to finish restoring the icon. Try again; if only the launcher image is unchanged, tap “Update home screen icon”.
Other settings were restored, but the app icon could not be fully restored. Try again in App icon settings.
Unable to open the image picker
Image saved. Use the button below to apply it to the home screen.

Custom icons use a system home screen shortcut. Launcher support and your confirmation may be required. The original icon in the app list and system settings remains unchanged. After choosing an image, add or update the home screen icon. Restoring the default also attempts to update an existing shortcut; it does not create a new one.\n\nThe image stays on this device and is included in a full configuration export. Importing restores the image without changing the home screen. Apply it manually on this page.
Unable to read this image. Choose another image.
Drag to position the image. Pinch or use the slider to zoom. The square area is saved as the icon; the launcher determines its final shape.
Unable to save the image. Try again.
\n\nThe app icon image will also be restored from the file, without changing the home screen icon automatically.
